blurb: South Park Brewing Co is a brewery and restaurant located in Colorado Springs, Colorado. They serve craft beer including beer to go in various formats and a food menu featuring smash burgers and fried chicken sandwiches. The brewery hosts events and welcomes families and dogs on the patio.
